title: Blue Hair
lyrics:
[00:15.84]She asked me how to be funny
[00:19.21]But that's not something you can teach
[00:28.30]What seemed so blue in the sunlight
[00:33.20]By the night was a pale green
[00:41.99]And I tried to hold her
[00:47.52]But it didn't really last long
[00:50.52]She's getting older
[00:53.97]I guess she's gotta cut her blue hair off
[01:12.42]She asked me if she was pretty
[01:15.61]Well, it's clear that the girl's a fraud
[01:24.87]There's really no way of winning
[01:27.55]If, in their eyes, you'll always be a dumb blonde
[01:38.49]And she cried over nothing
[01:43.85]So there was nothing I could do to stop
[01:47.40]Her from cutting
[01:51.35]Her beautiful blue hair off
[02:09.04]It looked like cotton candy
[02:11.72]And just as quick to get licked away
[02:21.56]Last I heard, she was living
[02:26.27]With a boy who acts his age
[02:35.10]And I guess I'll just miss her
[02:40.20]Even though she isn't even really gone
[02:43.52]But things are just different
[02:47.25]Ever since she cut her blue hair off
